_note: Bolt / stud dimensions transcribed from the SPX Bolting Systems "Stud Size and Nut (Hex) Size" chart, filled out with width across flats from the company torque chart for the sizes SPX omits. Inch and mm values are as printed where the chart gives both; hex_af_in is a labelled conversion (mm ÷ 25.4). pitch_mm is ISO 261 coarse pitch and is present only for the sizes that standard publishes (M4–M64) — nothing above M64 is guessed. Stud LENGTH is deliberately absent: it comes from the flange spec, never from a table.
